channel.title: Nuuu Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Nuuu for Mac.

item.title: 1.0.0-beta.2
item.description:
# Nuuu 1.0 Beta 2
Nuuu 1.0 Beta 2 continues the universal macOS Big Sur-and-later prerelease with the latest cleanup, navigation, About, menu, and telemetry fixes.
- Adds Help actions for Apple feedback, the Nuuu website, support, and user feedback. - Adds a custom About Nuuu window with build information and product links. - Adds Quick Scan and Clean My Mac to the File menu; Clean My Mac opens Discover's storage cleanup options. - Improves app-uninstall attribution and protects unrelated diagnostic and project files. - Tags Sentry reports with the Nuuu release and exact app build for reliable crash triage. - Keeps TelemetryDeck and Sentry configuration embedded in the published bundle, with privacy filtering and remote kill-switch support.
This prerelease is universal for Intel and Apple-silicon Macs running macOS Big Sur or later. It is Sparkle-signed for direct updates inside Nuuu but is not Apple-notarized.

item.title: 1.0.0-beta.1
item.description:
# Nuuu 1.0 Beta 1
Nuuu 1.0 Beta 1 is a major prerelease focused on a faster, calmer cleanup experience and a more useful live view of your Mac.
- Redesigns Discover, Analytics, Schedule, Junk Cleanup, App Cleanup, and Files Cleanup with responsive layouts, polished motion, improved dark-mode contrast, and persistent navigation state. - Adds live memory and performance insights with clearer memory accounting, installed-app and system-app grouping, and safer app quitting. - Improves large-file, duplicate, installer, leftover, and app cleanup review flows with better selection states, history, thumbnails, and lightweight completion feedback. - Makes scans and cleanup more responsive through bounded work, throttled progress updates, batched duplicate removal, and non-blocking UI updates. - Strengthens cleanup safety with explicit approval, path and identity validation, protected project-file handling, and clearer review-only recommendations. - Adds calmer contextual notifications, deep links, custom analytics and schedule date ranges, and updated Nuuu branding and app icon.
This prerelease is universal for Intel and Apple-silicon Macs running macOS Big Sur or later. It is Sparkle-signed for direct updates inside Nuuu but is not Apple-notarized. A fresh installation may show a macOS security warning.

item.title: 0.2.0-beta.8
item.description:
# Nuuu 0.2 Beta 8
This prerelease enables the production telemetry and crash-reporting pipeline.
- Embeds the TelemetryDeck app ID, Sentry DSN, and remote telemetry config in the packaged build. - Sends anonymous analytics and reliability signals to the live TelemetryDeck dashboard instead of hidden debug test mode. - Keeps analytics, reliability, and crash reporting enabled by default while still respecting the remote config kill switch. - Includes the latest cleanup history, scan review, and performance fixes from Beta 7.
Crash reports and anonymous telemetry stay privacy scoped: file paths, prompts, and personal content are not collected.

item.title: 0.2.0-beta.7
item.description:
# Nuuu 0.2 Beta 7
This prerelease improves cleanup review, scan speed, and history visibility.
- Adds thumbnail previews and Show in Finder actions for large files. - Speeds up duplicate and large file scan review flows. - Keeps cleanup history for junk, large files, duplicate files, and Empty Trash events. - Adds duration filters and summary cards to history popups. - Improves stale-result handling after files are moved to Trash. - Smooths scan loader animation and tightens history popup spacing.
This testing build is Sparkle-signed but not Apple-notarized. macOS may display a security warning during installation.

item.title: 0.2.0-beta.6
item.description:
# Nuuu 0.2 Beta 6
This prerelease fixes Empty Trash for users whose Mac still denies direct access to `.Trash` even after Full Disk Access appears enabled.
- Keeps the safe direct FileManager empty-trash path as the first attempt. - Adds a Finder Empty Trash fallback when macOS denies direct Trash access, so Finder can surface any required system approval in front of the user. - Adds regression coverage for denied direct Trash access.
This testing build is Sparkle-signed but not Apple-notarized. macOS may display a security warning during installation.

item.title: 0.2.0-beta.4
item.description:
# Nuuu 0.2 Beta 4
This prerelease is for tester validation of the latest Nuuu fixes and polish.
- Adds privacy-first analytics, reliability telemetry, crash-reporting abstractions, privacy settings, and telemetry documentation. - Fixes app update publishing so users on older 0.2 builds can see the newest Sparkle update. - Improves large-file scanning, app cleanup loading, uninstall reliability, permission-focus behavior, and RAM optimization responsiveness. - Redesigns the Schedule section to match Nuuu styling and shows accurate last-run cleaned item and freed-space metrics. - Keeps telemetry privacy-first: no file names, paths, app names, assistant prompts, tokens, or cleanup contents are collected.
This testing build is Sparkle-signed but not Apple-notarized. macOS may display a security warning during installation.
